10 players (Judge was 11th and decided not to play. Sucks)

Out of the seven games, including the final, five ended in a timeout with just round three having two "normal" games.

No one was ousted in the finals so the tournament win went for teh hig seed. If the final had lasted for 5-10 seconds more Tom would've ousted Lauri and won the game.
